label: POST-HOC. The delivered23 holdout has already been unsealed and its R0/COISC results are known; development ablation results are known. Descriptive mechanism analysis only; the locked delivered23 decision (prediction NI FAIL 3/3, sensitivity gates PASS 3/3) is unchanged regardless of outcome.
data: the 23 delivered sources exactly as stored in delivered23 window_level_raw_results.npz (history, future, target per source; identical across seeds and variants); no re-preprocessing
inference_path: paper_models.VanillaLSTM(configs/normalization.json) with strict state_dict load; paper_eval.predict(batch=256); screen.sensitivity in batches of 256 under no_grad (identical to frozen_diagnostics.paired_inference)
reproduction_check: R0 and COISC re-inferred through this path must equal the stored delivered23 prediction and sensitivity arrays (max abs diff reported; expected 0). If not zero but <=1e-5, report and proceed; if larger, stop and report HOLDOUT_PATH_NOT_REPRODUCED
aggregation: equal-source over 23 sources in bootstrap_draws.npz source_order; 20000 frozen source-cluster draws (counts); PSM via frozen_evaluate.SourceMedian; percentile 95% CIs
endpoints_per_variant_and_seed: Tp MAE at 10/30/60/90/120 s; all7 MAE averaged over outputs and the five horizons
Tp PLE, WSR, PSM with prior lags; Tp WSR/PSM with ALL_STEPS and T20_G0 masks from the parent protocol; T6 PLE with prior lags

contrasts.vs_R0: formal delivered23 gate readouts applied to each ablation: Tp 120 s MAE contrast CI upper <= 0.005; PLE and WSR point <= 0.9xR0 and CI upper of (V - 0.9xR0) <= 0; PSM point >= max(0.2xR0, 0.0005) and CI lower of (V - 0.2xR0) >= 0 and (V - 0.0005) >= 0
contrasts.COISC_vs_L0: paired bootstrap CI of COISC - L0 for Tp 120 s MAE, PLE, WSR, PSM (prior lags) and WSR ALL_STEPS; primary attribution contrast

pre_specified_interpretation.attribution: the holdout PLE/WSR change of COISC is called regularizer-specific for a metric only if the COISC - L0 CI excludes 0 in the favourable direction on at least 2/3 seeds
pre_specified_interpretation.NI_cost: if L0's Tp 120 s MAE contrast vs R0 is near 0 while COISC's is not, the holdout NI failure is attributed to the regularizer rather than to extra head training; described, not tested
pre_specified_interpretation.reporting: all variants, seeds and endpoints reported; no rerun with other settings
